attributes.board_name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Nursing

rules.accepted_credit_types: No Board-approved list; programs must meet 244 CMR 5.00 (lectures, workshops, academic courses, supervised clinical, home study, web-based). CME/AMA credit and programs approved by other boards of nursing generally qualify. CPR, ACLS/PALS recertification and workplace in-services do not count.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Board may request proof at any time (audit or complaint); keep CE records for the last 2 renewal periods (4 years).

topics.who: one-time training in care of patients with cognitive impairment incl. Alzheimer's/dementia (Chapter 220 of 2018); no set hours; existing licensees had to finish by Nov 7, 2022

rules.notes: RN license expires on your birthday in even-numbered years; hours must be earned in the 2 years before renewal. The Board also lists Domestic and Sexual Violence Training (Chapter 260); hours/frequency not stated on the Board pages read.
